warnings: This small view prints grid markers 1, D and E with D-E 2.50 and 1.00 past E. The structural set has no grid E (S-01 footings stop at D; ten other views letter the rows A-D at 3.50 / 3.50 / 2.50). Decided by op01 precedence and geometry: printed D = structural C, printed E = structural D — the posts drawn here at D and E are the columns C1 at C1 and D1 (S-02 draws C1 alone at D1 over the open stair bay), and E + 1.00 is the roof edge D' (10.50) that S-03/S-04/A-04 print 1.00 past D. Refs are written in structural lettering; the losing reading (a real grid E 2.50 beyond D) would put this wall plate outside the roof drawn on S-04, so it is rejected.
Member: อะเส C-150x50x20x2.3 mm., top at +4.01 — the low support of Truss T3's left end over the stair bay (S-05 Truss T3).
